description: Agent Readiness: submit an agent’s access list (systems, the actions it can perform there, access level, data it can reach) and its authority grant (actions it may take, system, limit, approver, data it may use). The signed report names every reachable action and every reachable data set outside the grant, including broad admin, write or read access, every granted action the access cannot perform, and the scoping change that brings each into line. Approver bands are wever_approval-chain-check. Verdict access_exceeds_authority, authority_exceeds_access or aligned. POST /api/authority-scope-check. Reads only the material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-readiness-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-readiness/.
